text:
maria: Quick update — embargo window moved up by 2 hours for EU/APAC. We need to reshuffle the prebrief slots and lock quotes for fact-check. Please confirm availability. :clock2:
jake: Ugh timing. I'm on calls until 11:30am PT but can take a late slot. Can we push the APAC briefing earlier?
olivia: I can cover an earlier APAC slot at 7am PT if needed. @maria — do we have a backup speaker for the performance questions?
maria: @olivia that would help, thanks. Backup for perf is @bethany — she's ok with 7am PT. I'll update the calendar.
bethany: Confirmed. Also we should freeze quote "%22Redwood cuts inference costs by up to 3x%22" until legal signs off — sending to legal now.
sam: FYI pressdeck v3 uploaded: https://redwood-internal/share/pressdeck-v3.pdf — note the benchmark slide has the updated numbers. Do not share externally until quote freeze lifted.
maria: Pressbot: set embargo 2026-05-02T08:00:00Z
pressbot: Embargo set for 2026-05-02T08:00:00Z. Notifications sent to enrolled reporters.
jake: For the fact-check: who owns the footprint/instance count detail? We had a disagreement on the LaMDA comparison slide.
bethany: I own infra numbers — attaching the snippet to fact-check: "tests run on 8x A100s with sequence len 1024, batch 8". Please use that exact phrasing.
maria: Great — two action items: (1) @bethany finalize infra quote & send to legal, (2) @jake coordinate new briefing times with analyst ops and update the calendar invites. I'll ping sales for embargo-sensitive lists.
olivia: Also, quick note: if any analyst wants a demo, schedule after briefings; don't give model access beforehand. Keeps footprint consistent. :lock:
jake: I'll handle invites + confirm reporter list. If anyone sees a reporter in both APAC and EU lists, flag for handoff.
maria: Thanks team. I'll follow up with a tiny prebrief checklist in ~30m. :white_check_mark:
